sync.title: Keep this in sync
sync.pausedDagster: The schedule is paused in Dagster, by a person or by the failure sensor after {count, plural, other {# consecutive failures}}. Dagster owns that state: fix the source, then resume the schedule in Dagster (platform team). “Sync now” runs once and does not resume it.
sync.pausedLedger: Paused after {count, plural, other {# consecutive failures}} — fix the source, then press “Sync now” to resume (or “Reset & full re-sync” to start over).
sync.kafka: Streaming source — new messages are appended, tracked by Kafka partition offsets. No cursor to pick; de-duplicate downstream if producers retry.

hint.salesforceFull: Re-pulls every record over the Salesforce API each run — API-quota heavy; best for small objects.
hint.salesforceIncremental: Pulls only records modified since the last sync (SystemModstamp) over the Salesforce API. Deletes are not detected (v1).
hint.kajabiFullNoCursor: Re-pulls every record over the Kajabi API each run — this resource documents no timestamp cursor, so full refresh is the only honest mode.
hint.kajabiFull: Re-pulls every record over the Kajabi API each run — best for small resources.
hint.kajabiUpdated: Pulls only records updated since the last sync (updated_at) over the Kajabi API. Updated records re-append — de-duplicate by id downstream; deletes are not detected.
hint.kajabiCreated: Pulls only records CREATED since the last sync (created_at) — Kajabi documents no updated-at cursor for this resource, so edits to existing records are NOT picked up (run a full refresh to capture them). Deletes are not detected.
hint.full: Re-copies the whole table each run. Simple and exact — best for small tables.
hint.append: Adds only rows newer than the last sync (may re-deliver late rows — exact-once needs "Update by key").
hint.merge: Upserts changed rows by key. Best on a daily-ish cadence.

connectedSource.title: Source
connectedSource.frozen: Copy frozen. A platform admin revoked the exposure this synced copy was adopted from — the sync is disabled and no new data will land, but the last-landed copy is kept and stays fully queryable. Re-adopt from an active exposure to resume syncing.
connectedSource.frozenAsOf: Copy frozen as of {date}. A platform admin revoked the exposure this synced copy was adopted from — the sync is disabled and no new data will land, but the last-landed copy is kept and stays fully queryable. Re-adopt from an active exposure to resume syncing.
connectedSource.revoked: Source revoked by a platform admin. This dataset was adopted from a connection exposure that has since been revoked — no data is shown, and preview / Talk are disabled. Re-adopt the table from an active exposure to restore it.
connectedSource.driftedSync: Source drifted. The catalog snapshot no longer lists this table where it was adopted — it may have been renamed or moved. The next sync may fail until the source is confirmed; confirm the source and re-adopt if it moved.
connectedSource.driftedLive: Source drifted. The catalog snapshot no longer lists this table where it was adopted — it may have been renamed or moved. Reads still run against the last-known FQN; confirm the source and re-adopt if it moved.
connectedSource.modeSync: Sync — a governed copy lands into your domain on a schedule; reads hit the local copy
connectedSource.modeLive: Live (federated) — every read runs straight against the source
connectedSource.lastOkRows: last successful sync {date} · {count, plural, other {# row(s)}}
connectedSource.recentRuns: {count, plural, other {# recent run(s)}} — see the full history in the sync panel. Last: {status} at {date}.
connectedSource.guardrails: Guardrails: preview is bounded to the first rows (LIMIT); statistics are computed on a bounded sample and labeled “sampled, approximate”. Define metrics on a synced copy — not a live connected dataset.
